wikipediaSummary.title: New York Dolls (album)
wikipediaSummary.description: 1973 studio album by New York Dolls
wikipediaSummary.extract: New York Dolls is the debut studio album by the American rock band New York Dolls, released on July 27, 1973, by Mercury Records. An influential precursor to the 1970s punk rock movement, the eponymous album has been acclaimed as one of the best debut records in rock music and one of the greatest rock albums ever.
